reason: A new style is required by the operator directive. The episode needs a cinematic abandoned-world mood capable of showing both rapid infrastructure failure and decades of ecological succession, so distressed ink wash with restrained charcoal abrasion provides atmospheric scale, decay, moisture, soot, rust, and encroaching vegetation without becoming photorealistic. It deliberately avoids reusing cinematic_abandoned_world_charcoal_001, which is among the most recent styles, and also avoids repeating its charcoal-primary treatment by making ink wash the dominant medium while preserving the requested abandoned-world texture.
